text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The spring Tenno Sho that my third win
depends on—I'd like Rice
there too.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Rice... in the Tenno Sho?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Why risk her chance to make history by
letting another strong
contender onto the
field?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: The booing at the Kikuka Sho...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Denying Bourbon's Triple Crown was a feat
worthy of praise, and yet
the exact
opposite reactions were the loudest.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
As chance would have it, the stakes at the
Kikuka Sho are closely
mirrored by the
upcoming Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Because there's a certain sight I would
have her see there.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Some things can only be taught by a
fellow runner, and I wish to take
on that
responsibility.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
You, Trainer, have your own part to
play—getting Rice into the Tenno
Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The importance of this race for McQueen
cannot be understated.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
No doubt she thought long and hard
before making this request.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But is she really okay with this?
Won't Rice
being there distract her
from her own
running?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Heh. You think I'm going to lose, do you? I am very hurt.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: For the record, I have no intention of losing. On my pride as a Mejiro, I shall achieve my third consecutive Tenno Sho title.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
You sure have a difficult job before you.
No matter which of us wins,
you'll have to
console the other.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She flashes a teasing smile, but the
upcoming race is anything but fun
and
games to her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If this sight she wants Rice to see is
that
important to her, then who
am I to say no?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Good. I trust you'll keep your word.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At training the following day...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... Um, how was my time?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her times aren't bad. But when she practices against anyone, she just can't win.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Getting booed at the Kikuka Sho has
made her shy away from being

competitive.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Good. You'll be able to contend in the big
leagues.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Good. You'll be able to contend in the big
leagues.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
The big leagues? Have you decided my
next race?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She won't like the decision.
But if she's to
ever win again...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...What? The spring Tenno Sho?!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
You have what it takes. You proved that at
the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
B-but... McQueen has her third
consecutive Tenno Sho riding on that

race...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: It's so important to her, I can't compete. Even if I win, I'll just...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower hangs her head as if she can
hear the boos again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Practice ends without her agreeing to the
race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I won't force her to race if she doesn't
want to, but this can't go on
forever.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: You're Rice's trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon interrupts her training to
talk to me.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Hey, Bourbon. Training all by yourself?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Hey, Bourbon. Training all by yourself?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes. An injury I sustained after the
Kikuka
Sho has finally healed.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
How is Rice doing? Is she still hung up on
what happened?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Bourbon was up on that stage too, right
beside Rice.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She saw firsthand how much damage the
booing did.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I see...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...I train after-hours like this not
because
of some directive to achieve
victory, but
because I want to.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I simply can't stifle the urge to run.
And it
all started when I lost to
Rice.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I want to race her again,
and I want to win
this time. That is why I
train.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rice was the first ever to put a
scratch on
Bourbon's undefeated
record.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sounds like she's converted that setback
into motivation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rice was exactly the same way. Having a
rival pushed her to work
harder.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Is there anything I can do? In order to
meet her on the turf once
more.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Bourbon...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"I want to win." The same ambition that
Rice has lost, Bourbon has
gained anew.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If Rice could see Bourbon now...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Understood. I'll do as you wish—I mean, it
is my wish to help.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Noticing the semblance of a smile on
Bourbon's lips, I can't help but
feel like
things are looking up.
